No recent learning cycles or opportunities generated by AI, suggesting potential issues with AI functionality or configuration.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review AI configurations and ensure it is properly integrated and functioning to generate trading opportunities.
Evaluate and potentially adjust active trading strategies to align with current market conditions.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough investigation of CPU usage to identify and resolve bottlenecks or high-load processes.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Check AI system logs and configurations to ensure it is operational and capable of generating trading opportunities.
